---
title: "UCD College of Science Teaching Excellence Award"
date: "2021-03-15"
description: "Recognised for student engagement, continuous curriculum development, and contribution to Widening Participation at UCD."
categories: [event]
---

At the UCD College of Science Council Meeting in March 2021, I was honoured to receive a **Teaching Excellence Award** in recognition of the variety of techniques used to engage and motivate students, continuous curriculum revision and development, and engagement with the Widening Participation programme at University College Dublin.
